findings.title: Persistence requirement contradicts baseline orbit-run-summary-emit's invocation/emit model
findings.recommendation: The requirement writes audit-drift-<TS>.json to the change's .orbit-runs/ 'when invoked in a change context (e.g., from system-mode review or pre-archive)' and to a project-level location only 'when invoked standalone with no change context'. The fork baseline contradicts both halves: orbit/specs/orbit-run-summary-emit/spec.md:419 scopes audit-drift emits to STANDALONE invocations only; :441-444 state no separate audit-drift JSON is written for the inline-during-archive pass (corroborated by the B2 archive's .orbit-runs/, which has zero audit-drift JSONs); and :397-401 define a change-scoped standalone form /orbit:audit-drift <name> that the delta's model omits. Overlay-internal inconsistency the D-b3-3 bidirectional check missed.

recommendation_options.label: A
recommendation_options.body: Align the delta to the baseline: rewrite the persistence requirement around the emit spec's model — change-scoped standalone (/orbit:audit-drift <name>) → change .orbit-runs/; project-wide standalone → orbit/.orbit-runs/; library call → folded into the review emit; pre-archive → captured in archive-<TS>.json audit.* fields, no separate file. Add an 'Invoke change-scoped' scenario defining the <name> positional the baseline depends on.

recommendation_options.label: B
recommendation_options.body: If a separate pre-archive audit-drift JSON is actually desired, add MODIFIED deltas for orbit-run-summary-emit (:419/:441-444) and orbit-archive-modifications in this change rather than shipping a silent contradiction (cuts against D-b3-2's relocation-only framing).
